industrial-era.options.server_stick.tool: How the stick moves on a server. Java moves only by its keys, so a server's anticheat may pull you back for the stick's own speed and angle. Analog: as you push it (servers that do not check). Free Direction: any angle at full speed, by turning the look the server sees (others see your head follow; it turns back to your view for every hit, use and block). D-pad: arrows on screen in the stick's place (a controller's stick takes the nearest of their eight directions), at full speed. A server you picked a mode for when it pulled you back keeps that one; change this while playing there to change it.
industrial-era.options.stick_prompt.tool: When a server keeps pulling you back while the stick moves you, ask how the stick should move there.
starling.stick_prompt.title: This Server Pulls You Back
starling.stick_prompt.body: Its anticheat (Grim or one like it) takes only the moves Java's keys make, and the stick's own speed and angle are not one of them. Pick how the stick moves here; Options > Controls > Controller Settings changes it any time.

industrial-era.extras.fullbright.tooltip: Show blocks and entities at full light, even in dark areas.
industrial-era.extras.dynamic_lights.too: Torches and other light sources held, dropped or on fire light the blocks around them.
industrial-era.extras.own_name_tag.toolt: Shows your name above your head in third person, as other players see it. Hidden when the server hides your team's names or you're invisible.
industrial-era.extras.hide_block_particl: Hides the debris particles that burst from a broken block and crumble off the one you mine. Other particles stay.
industrial-era.extras.auto_reconnect.too: Rejoins a server after a lost connection or a restart, never after a kick or ban.
industrial-era.extras.ui_sound_reserve.t: Sounds in the world leave 16 of the 247 sound channels free, so a flood of them (a big explosion) can't silence menu clicks.

industrial-era.extras.mouse_tweaks.toolt: Right-drag places one per slot, left-drag gathers the held item, Shift + left-drag moves every slot.
industrial-era.extras.mouse_tweaks_wheel: Down sends one item of the slot to the other side, up brings one back.
industrial-era.extras.sort.tooltip: Sorts the inventory, chests, barrels, ender chests and shulker boxes in creative tab order, merging stacks.
industrial-era.extras.sort_key.tooltip: Sorts the part under the cursor. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it.
industrial-era.extras.no_ai.tooltip: Hides and turns off every AI feature: agent control, industrial-era-ctl and the MCP servers. The launcher's switch too.
industrial-era.extras.agent_control.tool: Your own AI agent can play this game through industrial-era-ctl or an MCP client, on this computer only.
industrial-era.extras.discord_presence.t: Shows Playing Industrial Era on your Discord profile while Discord runs: menus, single player or multiplayer, the dimension and the time played. Never a world's name or a server's address.
